classificationMeaning.bounded-existing-feature: A safe native subset exists. This is not byte parity or an all-alternatives claim.
classificationMeaning.specific-variant-requires-proof: The concrete variant remains an explicit proof obligation until a supported finite repair is tested.
classificationMeaning.deliberate-safety-difference: Unsafe or editorial source behavior is not a compatibility target.
classificationMeaning.active-native-alias-preserved: Accepted native spellings intentionally remain unchanged.
classificationMeaning.conservative-date-shape-boundary: A reviewed preservation boundary, not claimed automatic coverage.
classificationMeaning.specialized-contract-unproved: A specialized contract remains unavailable, and no equivalent automatic replacement is claimed.
classificationMeaning.bounded-calendar-precision-operation: The exact concrete source witness reaches a calendar-valid native value without changing supplied precision. Broad original regex alternatives are not implied.
classificationMeaning.active-native-value-preserved: An already valid complete native value or marker is intentionally retained.
classificationMeaning.native-alias-and-missing-template-bounda: Every literal branch is classified: an accepted native alias is preserved, and a confirmed missing template is not assigned an invented replacement.
classificationMeaning.missing-native-template-preserved: The exact target is confirmed missing. Its complete call stays unchanged rather than assuming an unrelated contract.
classificationMeaning.native-status-semantics-preserved: The accepted native status field retains its supplied value and role. This is not a claim that every value is a correct statement about the external URL.
classificationMeaning.confirmed-missing-source-interface-prese: A successful primary query confirms that the exact source interface is missing, and the existing target requires different supplied roles. Preserve the complete source to avoid activating unrelated output.

nonTextFeatures.boundary: All declared text substitution entries are enumerated with source hashes and matching witnesses. A matched pattern is not a proof that every alternative is safe.

Four declared draft citation rules are not in the source execution order and are not counted as active functionality.

foreignStateBoundary2_19.meaning: Unproved foreign status aliases or enums are not activated. A field mapping in an imported catalog is insufficient evidence of the native target role or link/archive behavior. Accepted native status keys and values keep their pinned native semantics.
